repsonse.reasoning: This column defines the dependent variable or response in the statistical model.

parameter.reasoning: This column defines the independent variables or factors being tested in the model.

estimate.reasoning: This column holds the calculated coefficient (the estimated effect) for each parameter.

95% CI lower bound.reasoning: This defines the lower boundary of the 95% confidence interval around the estimate.

95% CI upper bound.reasoning: This defines the upper boundary of the 95% confidence interval around the estimate.
